checkpoint_review: The Router correctly identified the main geometric and functional features of the cleaver (rectangular blade, cutting edge position). However, it was too lenient in marking 'Thick spine' as untestable; while the exact thickness is hard to measure due to blur, the visual representation lacks the distinct top-edge highlight or shadow separation expected of a thick cleaver spine, appearing instead as a flat 2D shape. The Router also marked handle-related checkpoints as untestable due to cropping/blur, which is accurate given the image constraints. The expert classifier strongly confirms the class alignment (cleaver), supporting the Router's positive verdicts on visible geometry.
artifact_review: The Router identified blur (severity 3) and text gibberish (severity 2). I agree with these findings but believe the severity of the blur/text issue is underestimated regarding its impact on realism. The 'text' on the blade is not just illegible; it is a nonsensical smudge that breaks the material illusion of stamped steel. Additionally, the Perceptual Quality Auditor flagged 'compression' artifacts (severity 0.4/moderate), which aligns with the Router's observation of softness but suggests the degradation is structural (pixelation/blockiness) rather than just optical blur. The blade edges lack the crisp specular highlights of real steel, appearing 'waxy' or melted into the background, a subtle texture anomaly the Router noted but didn't fully penalize. The combination of compression artifacts and AI-smoothing creates a low-fidelity result that significantly detracts from the object's perceived material quality.
alignment_reasoning: Strong class confirmation by expert classifier (Top-1: cleaver). All testable geometric and functional checkpoints passed. Minor deduction for the inability to verify spine thickness and handle details due to image quality/cropping, though this is largely an artifact issue rather than alignment failure.
artifact_reasoning: Significant blur and compression artifacts reduce clarity. Text/logo on blade is malformed/gibberish (AI artifact). Blade edges lack realistic metallic definition, appearing soft/waxy. Expert auditor confirmed moderate compression distortion. These issues compound to lower the artifact score below average.
key_defects: Severe blur and compression artifacts obscuring detail
Illegible/nonsensical text logo on blade surface
Lack of crisp metallic edge definition (waxy appearance)
Inability to verify spine thickness due to rendering quality
